interpolation.madsenBetweenNodeMeaning: Application interpolation between 13 published annual p50 values; not a reconstruction of the authors' fitted GAMLSS model.

limits: This policy selects an educational population central value, not a diagnostic reference interval.
Madsen represents chronological-age models pooling pubertal stages; a Tanner stage is neither inferred nor required.

The published Madsen table includes an exact age-18 node, retained for interpolation below 18. Routing at age 18 uses the Walravens 18–29 group mean; the source node does not extend Madsen to completed age 18-19.
Reference values genuinely differ at source and adult group boundaries. A smooth illustrative display transition cannot supply a patient mean or median or modify source values.
The existing term-infant Busch profile, graphical readability gate and gap from 1 to less than 3 years remain unchanged.

The childhood Kelsey record retains all source points from 3 through 88 years so restricted applicability does not change source PCHIP tangents; these retained nodes do not authorize adult comparison.
Adult total-testosterone comparisons use the seven exact Table 1 arithmetic means from Walravens 2025/2026, not free-testosterone medians, reference limits or a normal/abnormal classification.

Walravens contains heterogeneous healthy younger and community-dwelling older cohorts. Its morning fasting LC-MS/MS group differences do not isolate causal aging or establish the patient's sampling conditions.
The final adult group is eligible through exact age 86 only. A graphical tail beyond that limit supplies no numerical patient comparison.
